statement: Make the first $20,000 of everyone's income tax-free

summary.why: The Alliance says income is taxed from the first dollar that pays for food, power and rent while wealth is lightly taxed.
summary.how: A universal, automatic threshold; it says everyone earning under about $178,150 would pay less. Upper rates of 34% ($78,100–$150,000), 39% ($150,000–$250,000) and 47% above $250,000.

statement: Introduce a 2.5% annual wealth tax on net wealth over $2 million, with a trust tax

summary.how: A couple would pay nothing on combined net wealth up to $4 million; the party estimates $6.59 billion a year and would resource IRD to enforce it.
